title: The header nobody asked for
description: The write-headers PreToolUse hook prepended a Generated by OrchestKit Claude Plugin banner (and sometimes an invented #!/bin/bash) to every new file a subagent wrote, invisibly to the tool call the author approved, and six such files reached committed .github/ workflows, templates and scripts in a consumer repo (#4403). The hook is now a compatibility no-op that returns the caller's content unchanged, a regression test covers every file type the old code touched, and the handler leaves the FH-ready ratchet baseline because it no longer imports node:fs. Pick a file type and compare what lands on disk before and after.
